plan.summary: BRO-5527: shows on the NY tax-credit lists had no capitalization, so /biz had no cost basis for them. Each gets the total offering amount from its production entity's SEC Form D (Regulation D notice), matched to the show by the filing's related persons (lead producers), its timing and, where the tax-credit payout list names the entity, that name. Filed figures, not estimates; notes that said no capitalization was reported are corrected. Model rerun on apply. (part 1 of 6: a-dolls-house-2023, a-strange-loop-2022, a-wonderful-world-the-louis-armstrong-musical-2024, aint-too-proud-2019, american-buffalo-2022)
steps: Filed figures: capitalization, a Form D citation, the estimate flag, and the filing in sources.
Notes that said no capitalization was reported now state the filed offering.
